Which south-west London borough saw the most crime in July?

23rd September
By Ezekiel Bertrand Reporter

Share

0 comments
0:00 / 0:00

Which south-west London borough had the most crime last month? (Image: Contributor)

Metropolitan Police figures show which south-west London borough recorded the most criminal offences in August.

South-west London, which includes Croydon, Sutton, Merton, Lambeth, Kingston-upon-Thames, Richmond-upon-Thames and Wandsworth, saw an overall rise in reported crime in August.

A total of 27,477 offences were logged in August, up 9.6 per cent on the number recorded in July.

READ MORE: Greens call for Sutton B&Q plan to be rejected as tower gets EVEN BIGGER

Lambeth recorded the highest number of offences in July, with 3,565 crimes reported.

Theft was the most common offence in the borough, with 1,307 incidents, followed by violence against the person with 913 reports.

Vehicle crime saw 238 offences recorded.

There were also 172 cases of arson and criminal damage, 250 public order offences, 159 robberies and 156 burglaries.

Croydon had the second-highest crime total, with 3,310 offences in July.

As in Lambeth, violence against the person and theft were the most frequently recorded crimes, with 914 and 646 reports, respectively.

Vehicle offences were the next most common at 316, followed by 227 cases of arson and criminal damage.

Wandsworth ranked third, with 2,323 offences reported during the month.

The borough recorded 623 incidents of violence against the person and 615 theft offences, alongside 386 vehicle crimes.

Arson and criminal damage, burglaries and public order offences had 126, 122, and 156 cases respectively.

Sutton was next in the rankings, with 1,171 offences reported in August.

This included 425 cases of violence against the person, 270 thefts and 116 vehicle offences.

Police also recorded 95 public order offences and 87 incidents of arson and criminal damage.

In Merton, 1,159 offences were recorded in August.

The most common crimes were violence against the person, with 368 reports, and theft, with 234.

Kingston and Richmond-upon-Thames recorded the lowest crime levels in south-west London during August.

Kingston saw 1,038 offences, including 348 cases of violence against the person and 290 thefts.

Richmond recorded 928 offences, making it the borough with the lowest total.
